instruction: Download and install the Materia GTK theme from gnome-look.org, then set it as the active window theme.

metadata.explanation: Task requires downloading and installing Materia GTK theme from gnome-look.org and activating it. Evaluator uses gsettings to verify gtk-theme is set to 'Materia'. Uses existing check_list metric with cache_file getter.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the core requirement: Materia GTK theme is set as active
Postconfig uses appropriate gsettings command to read gtk-theme configuration
Getter (cache_file) correctly retrieves the command output from cache
Metric (check_list) correctly uses regex pattern 'Materia' to match theme name in output
Expected value 'Materia' is semantically correct for the instruction requirement
Data flow is sound: postconfig executes command -> saves to file -> getter reads file -> metric validates content
Edge cases handled appropriately: if theme not installed, gsettings returns different value, evaluator returns 0.0
